description: Wahrgenommene Sicherheit der Strassen in der Stadt St.Gallen (Streetwise) is a dataset listed in Stadt St.Gallen open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Streetwise. Der Datensatz zeigt die wahrgenommene Sicherheit der Strassen in der Stadt St.Gallen. Die Daten basieren auf einer Analyse von Streetwise, welche mittels Algorithmus Fotos der Strassenabschnitte nach ihrer Sicherheitswahrnehmung analysieren. Mehr Informationen unter:. Coverage: St. Gallen. The portal files it under Mobility and Transport, Public order and security. Its keywords are Sicherheit, Wahrnehmung, Foto, Algorithmus, Strassen. The portal shows 867 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2021-11-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-daten-stadt-sg-ch-portal.
